members.name: checkcache
members.doc: Discard cache entries that are out of date. (This is not checked upon each call!)

members.name: getline
members.doc: Get a line for a Python source file from the cache. Update the cache if it doesn't contain an entry for this file already.

members.name: getlines
members.doc: Get the lines for a Python source file from the cache. Update the cache if it doesn't contain an entry for this file already.

members.name: updatecache
members.doc: Update a cache entry and return its list of lines. If something's wrong, print a message, discard the cache entry, and return an empty list.
